questions.question: Which is NOT a part of an optical microscope :

explanations.a: Incorrect. A light source is an essential component of an optical microscope for illuminating the specimen.
explanations.b: Incorrect. The eyepiece is a fundamental part of an optical microscope used to view the magnified image.
explanations.c: Incorrect. The objective lens is a key optical component responsible for primary magnification.
explanations.d: Correct. A thermocouple is a temperature-measuring device and is not a component of an optical microscope.

questions.question: The part of optical microscope that holds the specimen is called :

explanations.a: Incorrect. A diopter is a unit used to measure the optical power of a lens.
explanations.b: Incorrect. The base supports the microscope but does not hold the specimen.
explanations.c: Correct. The stage is the platform on which the specimen slide is placed and held for observation.
explanations.d: Incorrect. The arm supports the upper parts of the microscope and is used for carrying it.

questions.question: The optical microscope is supported on the part called :

explanations.a: Incorrect. The diaphragm controls the amount of light passing through the specimen.
explanations.b: Correct. The base is the bottom support of the microscope and provides stability to the entire instrument.
explanations.c: Incorrect. The stage holds the specimen slide but does not support the microscope.
explanations.d: Incorrect. The arm connects the base to the upper parts of the microscope and is used for carrying it.

questions.question: The part to illuminate and brighten the field of view is provided by :

explanations.a: Correct. The light source provides illumination to the specimen and brightens the field of view for observation.
explanations.b: Incorrect. The condenser lens focuses and directs light onto the specimen but does not generate the illumination.
explanations.c: Incorrect. The objective lens magnifies the image formed by the specimen.
explanations.d: Incorrect. The eyepiece is used to view and further magnify the image.

questions.question: The adjustment part in microscope through which microstructural features are brought to focus for viewing :

explanations.a: Incorrect. The turret is used to hold and rotate objective lenses of different magnifications.
explanations.b: Correct. The focus knobs are used to adjust the position of the specimen or objective lens to bring microstructural features into sharp focus for viewing.
explanations.c: Incorrect. A camera is used to capture images and is not involved in focusing.
explanations.d: Incorrect. The light source provides illumination but does not control focus.
